name: mosyn
description: Build Mosyn study sets, cards, pictures, and custom study games that appear live on your Android phone.

interface.shortDescription: Turn material into study sets on your phone.
interface.longDescription: Paste a list, a reading, or a call sheet and Mosyn builds the study set it implies, with a verified picture per entry, live in the Mosyn Android app. It can also write a custom study game for the set. You approve the connection once, in the app on your phone.
defaultPrompt: Turn these notes into a Mosyn study set.
Here is the call sheet. Help me learn everyone's name.
Build a study game for my newest Mosyn set.
